title: Human Work Model — Wave 6 Surface Retirement
principle: Retire duplicate human-facing operational surfaces permanently while preserving canonical authorities, necessary public journeys, and safe compatibility redirects.
retirementRules: No retired surface renders an operational UI.
Authenticated access, verification and billing readiness converge into Account Activation Context.
Mission, executor, role, assignment and company legacy entries redirect to canonical Human Work destinations.
Marketplace remains only as a compatibility entry to the distinct public/private mission-access journey at /foryou.

Public authentication, independent executor registration, invitation acceptance, private mission access, support, developer and status journeys remain separate because they are not duplicate authenticated operational surfaces.
Control Plane remains separate from Operations Plane.
Canonical domain authorities, Action Registry, truth, liveness, tenant isolation and authorization are unchanged.
finalModel: Today tells people what matters. Work lets them work. Context lets them understand. Account governs identity and readiness. Control Plane governs the platform.
